name: Detected field error signaled only by color
summary: An automatically detected invalid field is represented solely by a colored outline/icon without textual identification of the error.
recurring_structure: Red highlight marks a field as invalid but does not identify the affected item and describe what is wrong in text.
harm_mechanism: The presentation requires users to infer error meaning visually and lacks the textual detected-error description required by WCAG 3.3.1 in applicable cases.
context: An automatically detected input error where the user needs to find/correct the input.
applicability: Invalid field is automatically detected and error is not identified/described textually.
legitimate_contexts: Color is supplemental alongside accurate text associated with the invalid field.
Warning styling that is not an automatically detected input error.

usability: Users unable to interpret color or symbol alone may not know what to fix; not user-tested.
accessibility: WCAG 3.3.1 Level A textual error identification applies when input errors are auto-detected; no target audit performed.
maintainability: An unstructured error state could make localization harder; inferred, not measured.

counterexamples.summary: Red border plus clear text and associated correction explanation is an acceptable visual supplement subject to complete context tests.
counterexamples.context: Error message tied to invalid field, with color as redundant cue.

version_context: WCAG 2.2 2024 normative scope; GOV/WAI/Primer references; pinned primer/react 7f5303d803986887187d86dcebaeda22a4dc6823, no AT/runtime
